page:
Welcome and introduction to Elysia playground. Elysia is ergonomic backend TypeScript framework for developer experience and performance. Unique features: performance comparable to Golang, extraordinary TypeScript support with type soundness, built around OpenAPI, end-to-end type safety like tRPC, Web Standards support (runs on Cloudflare Workers, Deno, Bun, Node.js), designed for humans first. Can run directly in browser. Check API docs in left sidebar.
Questions: What is Elysia? What are key features? Where can you run Elysia?

Elysia characteristics: ergonomic framework, Bun-based backend, TypeScript first, spectacular performance, extraordinary type support, OpenAPI built-in, end-to-end type safety, Web Standards, designed for humans. Once users learn framework concepts, find it intuitive to work with.
Questions: What makes Elysia different? What is type soundness?

Playground structure: 3 sections divided as left (documentation/task), top-right (code editor), bottom-right (preview/output/console). Interactive learning environment for getting familiar with Elysia.
Questions: How is the playground organized?

Assignment task: modify code to respond with 'Hello Elysia!' instead of 'Hello World!'. Change content inside .get method. Solution: change 'Hello World!' to 'Hello Elysia!' in get route. Demonstrates route modification.
Questions: How do you modify handler responses?
